items.review_rationale: Reviewed symbolic powers of prime ideals as contractions from prime localization, and compared the equivalent kernel construction with the ordinary ideal power and the nonnegative exponent.

references.context: Ideal generated by n-fold products of members of p, with the zeroth power equal to R.
Ideal in localized ring generated by images of elements of p^n.

references.phrase: contraction of an ideal under R→R_p
references.context: Inverse image of localized ideal p^n R_p under the canonical localization map.
Ideal of elements mapping to zero in the localized quotient, equivalent to the contraction in this setting.

references.phrase: ordinary and symbolic ideal powers need not coincide
references.disposition: The localization-and-contraction construction defines symbolic power without asserting equality with the ordinary ideal power.
